extraction: Cross-model agent orchestration: agents using different LLM backends (Claude, GPT, local). Coordination via standardized protocol. Maps to our harness: all agents use same backend (Claude Code). No cross-model needed. But pattern — protocol-based coordination — survives as unified-memory handoff protocol. If we add local model for Miss (faster patches), cross-model protocol needed. Currently not needed — single model.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: cross-model orchestration not needed (single backend), but protocol pattern validates unified-memory
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
